summary: The 120-day moratorium was adopted at a special meeting on 24 hours of public notice, is extendable by a further six months, and the City notified the Oregon Department of Land Conservation and Development on entering it.

source.citation: Regional reporting of the July 27 2026 special meeting

notes: The stated reason for the short notice, attributed to Mayor Beach Pace, was to prevent a rush of applications from data centers. Applications submitted before the moratorium may proceed, and it does not stop projects under construction or permits in process. Recorded as a dated statement of position, not as characterization.
confidence_note: The resolution is OBSERVED and filed separately; this entry records procedural facts around its adoption from secondary reporting only. The DLCD notification has not been located. The six-month extension is reported and has not been checked against the statute.
